preview: Interview experience of Diven Sirwani at Oracle for an FTE role consisting of an online test and two technical rounds.
content: NAME : Diven Sirwani Batch 2024 Information Technology ROUND 1 →ONLINE TEST The test was divided into four sections. There wasn’t any time constraint in these sections. You can switch between the sections and the time limit was for the overall test submission. Section 1: Coding Question (Medium-difficulty) Longest Increasing Subsequence Section 2: 10 MCQs on Aptitude. Section 3: 10 MCQs on vocabulary, paragraph reading, grammar, corrections, etc. Section 4: Coding Question (High-difficulty) REST API: Asteroid Orbits 40 students were shortlisted for role 1 and 15 for role 2 out of the 191 students that applied. Round 2 →Technical Round 1 : Duration : 45mins : offline There were 2 interviewers in the 1st round of interview. They both were friendly… Firstly they started with my introduction and then asked me about my internship work in very detail. Then they asked me questions on web development as i had mentioned fullstack web developer in my resume. They asked me : 1. What is react 2. What is virtual DOM 3. What is API 4. What is rest API Then they asked me if I was familiar with c++ or java. I said c++. Then they asked me all about pointers and their powers. Aka . Advantages and Disadvantages. Then they started to ask me if I knew about DBMS? They gave me 3 tables and asked me to print the output of their questions. It was A piece of cake IF YOU KNOW about joins in SQl. Basically you just had to apply joins on the table. (PRACTICE SQL … it is important) Later they asked me if I knew about trees or not…I said yes They asked me about all the traversals I know on trees. They asked me logic for → 1. level order traversal 2. left view of tree 3. right view of the tree 4. boundary traversal of the tree. They seemed to be impressed by the answer I gave , then they gave me a tricky puzzle which I had never seen before. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/puzzle-16-100-doors/ This was the puzzle they gave me. It took me a good 4-5 minutes to figure out the solution and finally I came up with the correct solution and both of the panelists seemed to be impressed by the approach I came up with. Later they asked me if I play guitar? (which i had mentioned in my resume :) haha…) The interviewer also used to play the guitar so we had discussion on our guitar skills and on the songs we both have written by ourselves hehe…And then we were done with the 1st Technical interview. NO HR questions were asked in this round. Round 3 →Technical Round 2 : Duration : 60mins : offline This round was the longest of all. In this round the VP himself was taking my interview along with 1 more interviewer. They started with my intro. My family background. And a few basics just to make me feel comfortable with them. Then again in this round they asked about my internship work in detail. Then they came up with more questions on SQL Joins. They also asked me about ACID properties and NORMALIZATION in DBMS. They also asked me on inheritance in OOPS in detail and i explained it to them using c++. Later they asked me a few questions in the MACHINE LEARNING domain as I had a project in it. I explained what it is and how it works. I explained my whole ML project to them. Then they came to a new topic LINKED LIST ….. YESSS They asked me what a linked list is and how to make one and few basic operations on a linked list. Then they asked me how to find if a cycle is present in the linkedlist or not and how to remove it. (If you have done the basics of DSA too , You would easily be able to answer it.) Then they asked me about web development technology as I had mentioned in my resume. Wish were simple yet important questions. TIP : Whatever technology you have used, be thorough with it. AS such no HR questions were asked in this round. And then it came to an end of this round. Only 2 rounds were conducted. Some were purely technical, some were technical + HR. The results were out in the evening. 19 students were selected (14 for role 1 and 5 for role 2) and I was luckily one of them to be selected in role 2. THANKYOU…! All the best.
